channel.title: News on Niloy Saha
channel.description: Recent content in News on Niloy Saha

item.title: RAN Testbed paper accepted in IEEE NOMS 2024
item.description: Our paper “Evaluating Open-Source 5G SA Testbeds: Unveiling Performance Disparities in RAN Scenarios” is accepted in IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium (NOMS), to be held in Seoul, South Korea from May 06 - 10, 2024. Link to pdf.

item.title: RAN Slicing paper accepted in IEEE JSAC
item.description: Our paper “Flexible RAN Slicing in Open RAN with Constrained Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning” is accepted in IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications (JSAC) Special Issue on Open RAN. Link to pdf.

item.title: Paper accepted at IEEE NOMS '23
item.description: Our paper “MonArch: Network Slice Monitoring Architecture for Cloud Native 5G Deployments” is accepted in is accepted in IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium (NOMS), to be held in Miami, Florida from May 08 - 12, 2023. Link to pdf. Link to code.

item.title: Network Slice Placement paper accepted in IEEE COMMAG
item.description: Our paper “Reinforcement Learning for Radio Resource Management in RAN Slicing: A Survey” is accepted in IEEE Communications Magazine Special Issue on Machine-Learning Enabled Zero-Touch Networks. Link to pdf.

item.title: RAN Slicing paper accepted in IEEE COMMAG
item.description: Our paper “Deep Reinforcement Learning Approaches to Network Slice Scaling and Placement: A Survey” is accepted in IEEE Communications Magazine Special Issue on Machine-Learning Enabled Zero-Touch Networks. Link to pdf.

item.title: Paper accepted at IEEE Future Networks World Forum
item.description: Our paper “SliceSecure: Impact and Detection of DoS/DDoS Attacks on 5G Network Slices” is accepted in the Symposium on Security for 5G and Future Networks at IEEE Future Networks World Forum, to be held in Montreal, Canada from October 12 - 14, 2022. Link to pdf.

item.title: Paper accepted in IEEE NOMS '22
item.description: Our paper “Demonstrating Network Slice KPI Monitoring in a 5G Testbed” is accepted in IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium (NOMS), to be held in Budapest, Hungary from April 25 - 29, 2022. Link to pdf.

item.title: Paper accepted in IEEE IoT Journal
item.description: Our paper “Q-Flag: QoS-Aware Flow-Rule Aggregation in Software-Defined IoT Networks” is accepted in the IEEE Internet of Things Journal. This work was done at the Smart Wireless Applications and Networking (SWAN) Lab at the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, India, under the guidance of Prof. Sudip Misra. Link to pdf.

item.title: Moved to Canada
item.description: I moved to Ontario, Canada and joined Prof. Raouf Boutaba's group at the University of Waterloo, where I will be working in the area of next-generation mobile networks.

item.title: Paper accepted at ACM FlexNets '21
item.description: Our paper “AI-driven Closed-loop Automation in 5G and beyond Mobile Networks” is accepted in ACM SIGCOMM Workshop on Flexible Networks Artificial Intelligence Supported Network Flexibility and Agility (FlexNets), to be held virtually from 23 - 27 August, 2021. Link to pdf.
